newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks close down, consolidation seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks close down, consolidation seen.

text.p: Taiwan share prices wavered in narrow-range trade on Saturday due to the absence of fresh market-moving news and brokers expected a consolidation to continue ahead of next week's Mid Autumn Festival.
The weighted index ended down 9.43 points or 0.15 percent at 6,490.09. Turnover was T$37.61 billion in the shortened Saturday session.

"Many investors have stepped to the sidelines as the index approaches the technological and psychological resistance of 6,600 points," said Tsao Chung-ping of Ting Kong Securities. "It seems the market is not yet ready to breach the barrier."
Brokers attributed the current consolidation in part to the slow entry of foreign equity funds.
"The market is waiting for new foreign liquidity, but foreign investors have also been very cautious recently," Tsao said.
Lower-priced industrials and asset-baced stocks attracted minor bargain-hunting, with most-active issue, Pao Shiang Industrial, rising 70 cents or 2.72 percent to T$26.4.
China Steel lost 10 cents or 0.38 percent to T$26 on profit-taking.
Acer Sertek Co, an affiliate of computer giant Acer Inc, surged by its daily seven percent limit for the fourth straight session after its Wednesday listing debut. It advanced T$2.9 to T$45.7.
Brokers expected the index to move between 6,400 and 6,600 points next week.
